page_title: PSG 1-1 CLE | PSG v Clermont 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' One of the players from PSG times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Gael Angoula has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlos Soler (PSG).

85' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Kylian Mbappe, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Goncalo Ramos (PSG), who beats Massamba N'Diaye with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
84' The game has come to an end for Habib Keita. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
81' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Goncalo Ramos (PSG), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
81' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

80' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Massamba N'Diaye makes a comfortable save. PSG earn a corner.
79' Flag up against Muhammed Cham (Clermont). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
76' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) sees a yellow card from Gael Angoula after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yohan Magnin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jeremy Jacquet (Clermont).
73' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
72' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) jumps into a tackle and Gael Angoula signals a foul. Clermont have a free kick.
71' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) reacts quickly to get to the rebound and from close range hits the left post.
71' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
70' PSG take a short corner kick.
70' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' That will be all from Randal Kolo Muani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kylian Mbappe (PSG).
67' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kang-In Lee (PSG) replacing Senny Mayulu.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Milan Skriniar will be replaced by Marquinhos (PSG).
66' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Massamba N'Diaye intercepts the ball.
65' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
65' Corner kick. Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is ready to send the ball into the box.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
63' That's the end of the game for Alan Virginius, who is replaced by Shamar Nicholson (Clermont).

63' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
60' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!

57' Danilo Pereira (PSG) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
57' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes a direct free kick.
56' The ball is crossed into the box and Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Massamba N'Diaye gets a glove on it to thwart him.
54' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
53' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. PSG have a corner.
51' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
49' Carlos Soler (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Senny Mayulu (PSG) heads on.
46' Referee Gael Angoula blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) will replace Jim Allevinah.
45+7' The goal by PSG is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
45+7' Wait! Referee Gael Angoula has indicated he is going to review the PSG goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
45+6' Senny Mayulu (PSG) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
45+4' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
45+3' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Marco Asensio (PSG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Massamba N'Diaye, who smothers the ball.
45' Massamba N'Diaye leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marco Asensio (PSG).
44' Marco Asensio (PSG) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
39' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Johan Gastien (Clermont) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Arnau Tenas.
37' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

32' 0 - 1 What a brilliant goal by Habib Keita (Clermont)! He collected a well-executed pass that had put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He took the goal-scoring opportunity with a shot to the middle of the goal past the keeper.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Jim Allevinah (Clermont) was too aggressive in his challenge.
29' Dangerous play by Chrislain Matsima (Clermont). Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Massamba N'Diaye easily deals with the threat.
24' Marco Asensio (PSG) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
16' It looks like Yoram Zague (PSG) saw red with that tackle. Gael Angoula won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
14' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Now PSG have a corner.
13' Substitution. Achraf Hakimi (PSG) on for Nordi Mukiele.
10' Nordi Mukiele (PSG) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' Nordi Mukiele (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
3' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Gael Angoula.
